sources.title: linkstar612/polyvox-models · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: polyvox-models Mirror of the model files Polyvox downloads at runtime. Every file here is an INT8 ONNX export produced in-house from an upstream checkpoint that permits redistribution. The paths match the relative paths the app stores the files under, so one base URL swap covers every key.
